layout_dets.text: An Ensemble Classification-Based Approach Applied

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to Retinal Blood Vessel Segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Muhammad Moazam Fraz*, Paolo Remagnino, Andreas Hoppe, Bunyarit Uyyanonvara, Alicja R. Rudnicka,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Christopher G. Owen, and Sarah A. Barman

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract—This paper presents a new supervised method for seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation of blood vessels in retinal photographs. This method uses

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an ensemble system of bagged and boosted decision trees and uti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lizes a feature vector based on the orientation analysis of gradient

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vector field, morphological transformation, line strength measures,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Gabor filter responses. The feature vector encodes information

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to handle the healthy as well as the pathological retinal image. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method is evaluated on the publicly available DRIVE and STARE

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: databases, frequently used for this purpose and also on a new pub-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lic retinal vessel reference dataset CHASE_DB1 which is a subset

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of retinal images of multiethnic children from the Child Heart and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Health Study in England (CHASE) dataset. The performance of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ensemble system is evaluated in detail and the incurred accuracy,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: speed, robustness, and simplicity make the algorithm a suitable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tool for automated retinal image analysis.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Index Terms—Ensemble classification, medical image analysis,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: retinal blood vessels, segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: I. INTRODUCTION

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: UNDUS imaging is being increasingly used to establish

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mality. A number of retinal blood vessel features (e.g., arteriolar

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: microaneurysms, nicking, narrowing) have been linked to sys-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: temic disease, and the morphological characteristics of retinal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: blood vessels themselves have been associated with cardiovas-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cular and coronary disease in adult life [1] and with retinopathy

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of prematurity in infancy [2]. The morphology of retinal vessels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (particularly arterioles) has also been linked to cardiovascular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: risk factors both in early and adult life [3]. The detection and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: analysis of the retinal vasculature is useful in the implementation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of screening programs for diabetic retinopathy, the evaluation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of retinopathy of prematurity, foveal avascular region detection,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: arteriolar narrowing detection, the determination of the rela-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tionship between vessel tortuosity and hypertensive retinopathy,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: measurement of vessel diameter to diagnose cardiovascular dis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eases and hypertension, and computer-assisted laser surgery [4].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The retinal map generation and branch point detection have been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used for temporal or multimodal image registration, retinal im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: age mosaic synthesis, optic disc identification, and fovea local-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ization and for biometric identification [4]. Retinal vessels are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: composed of arteriolars and venules, which appear as elongated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: branched features emanating from the optic disc within a retinal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image. Retinal vessels often have strong light reflexes along their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: centerline, which is more apparent on arteriolars than venules,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and in younger compared to older patients, especially those

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with hypertension. The vessel cross-sectional intensity profiles

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approximate to a Gaussian shape, or a mixture of Gaussians in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the case where a central vessel reflex is present. The nonvessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: region in the retina is not smooth due to the presence of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bright and dark lesions which includes hemorrhages, exudates,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: drusen, and the optic disc boundary. Most of the existing retinal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation methodologies are evaluated on the healthy retinal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images free from the pathologies; therefore, their performance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can be considerably degraded in the presence of lesions.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This paper presents a new supervised method for segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion of blood vessels by using an ensemble classifier of boosted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and bagged decision trees. The feature vector is based on gradi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ent orientation analysis (GOA), morphological transformation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with linear structuring element; line strength measures and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Gabor filter response which encodes information to success-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fully handle both normal and pathological retinas with bright

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and dark lesions simultaneously. The classifier based on the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: boot strapped and boosted decision trees is a classic ensemble

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classifier which has been widely used in many application areas

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of image analysis, but has not been applied within the frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work of retinal vessel segmentation for automated retinal image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: analysis. The obtained performance metrics illustrate that this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method outperforms most of the state-of-the-art methodologies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of retinal vessel segmentation. The method is training set robust

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as it offers a better performance even when it is trained on the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DRIVE database [5] and tested on the STARE database [6], thus

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: making it suitable for images taken under different conditions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: without retraining. This attribute is particularly useful when

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: implementing the screening programs over a large multiethnic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: population where there is a large variability in the background

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pigmentation level of the acquired retinal images. Moreover,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the algorithm is computationally fast in training and classifi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cation and needs fewer samples for training. The classification

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: accuracy of the ensemble can be estimated during the training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: II. RELATED WORK

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: There is a substantial amount of work reported in the literature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for detecting blood vessels in retinal images. A recent detailed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: review of these methods can be found in [4]. The vessel segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation algorithms can be classified into two broad categories: the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unsupervised and supervised methods.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: A. Unsupervised Methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The unsupervised methods can be further classified into tech-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: niques based on matched filtering, morphological processing,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel tracking, multiscale analysis, and model-based algo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rithms. The matched filtering methodology exploits the piece-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: wise linear approximation, the decrease in vessel diameter along

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vascular length, and the Gaussian-like intensity profile of retinal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: blood vessels and uses a kernel based on a Gaussian or its deriva-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tives to enhance the vessel features in the retinal image [6], [8]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Mathematical morphology in combination with curvature evalu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ation [9] and matched filtering for centreline detection [10], [11]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is also exploited for retinal vessel segmentation. The algorithms

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based on the vessel tracking [12] segment a vessel between

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two points using local information and work at the level of a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: single vessel rather than the entire vasculature. The multiscale

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approaches are based on scale-space analysis. The multiscale

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: second-order local structure of an image (Hessian) is examined

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and a vesselness measure is obtained on the basis of eigenvalue

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: analysis of the Hessian [13]. The model-based approaches in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: clude the vessel profile models [14]–[17], active contour mod-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: els [18], and geometric models based on level sets [19].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: B. Supervised Methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The supervised segmentation methods utilize ground truth

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: data for the classification of vessels based on given features.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Niemeijer et al. [20] extracted a feature vector for each pixel that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: consists of the Gaussian and its derivatives at multiple scales,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: augmented with the green plane of the RGB image, and then uses

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a K-nearest neighbor algorithm to estimate the probability of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel belonging to a vessel. Staal et al. [5] used ridge profiles to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: compute 27 features for each pixel and applied a feature selec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion scheme to pick those which result in better class separability

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by a kNN classifier. In [21], six features are computed by em-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ploying a multiscale analysis using a Gabor wavelet transform

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Gaussian mixture model (GMM) Bayesian classifier. Ricci

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Perfetti [22] used line operators and support vector machine

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (SVM) classification with three features per pixel. Lupascu et

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: al. [23] introduced a feature-based Ada-Boost classifier for ves-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sel segmentation which utilizes a 41-D feature vector at differ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ent spatial scales for each pixel. In [24], a 7-D feature vector is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computed by combination of moment-invariant and gray-level

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features and a five-layer feed-forward neural network is used

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for classification. You et al. [25] computed the feature vector

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by using the steerable complex wavelet followed by calculat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the line strength [22]; the SVM is used for semisupervised

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classification. In this study, we have presented a decision tree-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based ensemble classifier which requires fewer features and is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computationally simpler than other methods and also training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: set robust.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: III. METHODOLOGY

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: A. Feature Vector

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The feature vector contains the quantifiable measurement for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: each pixel in such a way that the classifier successfully differen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tiates the blood vessels and the bright and dark lesions. We have

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used a 9-D feature vector which includes the orientation analysis

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of gradient vector field (one feature) for removal of bright and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dark lesions with vessel enhancement, morphological transfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mation (one feature) for eradicating bright lesions, line strength

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: measures (two features), and a Gabor filter response at multi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ple scales (four features) for eliminating the dark lesions. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: intensity of each pixel in the inverted green channel is taken as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one of the features. All the features are extracted from the green

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plane of the RGB colored image without any preprocessing.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1) Orientation Analysis of a Gradient Vector Field: The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: blood vessels are localized by analyzing the orientation of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gradient vector field. The unit gradient vectors of the image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are highly discontinuous along the bilaterally symmetrical re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gions, i.e., the linear structures which represent the blood ves-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sels. Therefore, the blood vessels are localized by finding the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: discontinuities in the gradient orientation. The feature extrac-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion depends on the orientation of the gradient vector field not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: its magnitude; therefore, it is robust against low contrast and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nonuniform illumination [26].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The gradient vectors for the image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are approximated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by the first-order derivative operators in the horizontal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vertical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: directions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The gradient vectors

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are normalized by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dividing with their magnitude to compute the unit gradient vec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tors

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 5) Ensemble Classifier: Ensemble classification [29] is the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: process by which multiple classifiers are strategically generated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and combined to solve a particular machine learning problem.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Ensemble learning is primarily used to improve the classification

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: or prediction performance of a model, or reduce the likelihood

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of a poor or unfortunate selection. This approach is intuitively

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used in our daily lives where we seek the guidance of multiple

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: experts, weigh, and combine their views in order to make a more

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: informed and optimized decision. In the same way, the ensem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ble methods use multiple models or classifiers to obtain better

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: predictive performance by combining the results from many

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: weak learners into one high-quality ensemble predictor. In this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approach, we have used the decision trees as the classification

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model and the results of these weak learners are combined us-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing bootstrap aggregation also known as bagging [30] and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: boosting [31] algorithms.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In bagging, the decision trees are grown on the bootstrap

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: replicas of the training dataset which are generated by randomly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: selecting M observations out of N with replacement, where N

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is the training set size. The predicted responses of the indi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vidual classifiers are then combined by taking a majority vote

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of their decisions. For any given instance, the class chosen by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: most classifiers is the ensemble decision. Picking up the M out

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of N observations with replacement omits on average 37% of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: observations for each decision tree. These are “out-of-bag" ob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: servations and can be used to estimate the predictive power of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the classifier as well as the importance of each individual fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture from the feature vector in the decision-making process. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: average out-of-bag error is estimated by comparing the out-of-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bag predicted responses against the observed responses for all

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: observations used for training, which is an unbiased estimator

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the true ensemble error. The out-of-bag estimated feature of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: importance can be obtained by randomly permuting out-of-bag

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: data across one variable or column at a time and estimating the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: increase in the out-of-bag error due to this permutation. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: larger the increase, the more important the feature in classifica-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion. Thus, an attractive feature of bagging is that the reliable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: estimates of predictive power and feature importance can be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: obtained during the training process without supplying the test

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Boosting also creates an ensemble of classifiers by resam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pling the data, which are then combined by majority voting but

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it takes a different resampling approach than bagging, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: maintains a constant probability of 1/N for selecting each indi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vidual example. Given training dataset D of N instances for a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: binary classification problem, the first classifier C1 is trained on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a training subset D1 obtained using a bootstrap sample of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: N instances. The training data subset S2 for the second classifier

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: C2 is chosen such that exactly half of D2 is correctly classified

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by C1 and the other half is misclassified. The third classifier

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: C3 is then trained with instances on which C1 and C2 disagree.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The three classifiers are combined through a three-way major-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity vote. The altered distribution ensures that more informative

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: instances are drawn into the next dataset. This iterative distribu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion update makes the boosting algorithm a strong learner with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: arbitrarily high accuracy that is obtained by combining weak

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learners.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The methodology has been evaluated using two established

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The accuracy (Acc) is measured by the ratio of the total

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: number of correctly classified pixels to the number of pixels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: algorithm to detect the vessel pixels. Specificity (SP) is the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ability to detect nonvessel pixels. The positive predictive value

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (PPV) or precision rate is the probability that an identified vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel is a true positive. These metrics are defined in Table II

layout_dets.text: the FOV.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In addition, the performance of the algorithm is also measured

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with the area under receiver operating characteristic (ROC)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curve (AUC). An ROC curve is a plot of true positive frac-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions (SN) versus false positive fractions (1-SP) by varying the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: threshold on the probability map image.

layout_dets.text: C. Method Evaluation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The outcome the ensemble classifier is a vessel probability

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of each pixel to be a part of the vessel or not. The probability

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: map is often considered as a grayscale image such that the bright

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixels in this image indicate a higher probability of being vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel. The probability map for a CHASE_DB1 image is shown

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: V. DISCUSSION AND CONCLUSION

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this paper, we have presented an effective retinal vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation technique based on supervised classification using

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an ensemble classifier of boosted and bagged decision trees. We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have used a 9-D feature vector which consists of the vessel map

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: obtained from the orientation analysis of the gradient vector

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: field, the morphological transformation; line strength measures

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and the Gabor filter response which encodes information to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: successfully handle both normal and pathological retinas.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The important feature of bagged ensemble is that the reli-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: able estimates of the classification accuracy and feature impor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tance are obtained during the training process without supplying

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the test data. The ensemble classifier was constructed by using

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 200 weak learners and is trained on 20 0000 training samples

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: than other classification-based methods proposed by Lupascu

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. [23] and Soares et al. [21] where 789 914 and 106 samples

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are used, respectively.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our algorithm renders better AUC accuracy, sensitivity, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specificity measures than other state-of-the-art algorithms for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: both of the DRIVE and STARE databases, being fractionally

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: outperformed in terms of accuracy only by Ricci and Per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fetti [22] and Lupascu et al. [23] (for DRIVE only). This obser-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vation gains more importance by the fact that Lupascu's tech-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nique [23] used 41-D feature vector as compared to a 9-D feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vector (4-D in the case of reduced feature set, Table VI) used

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by our algorithm and approximately four times more training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: samples than this work. The Ricci method is proved to be very

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dependent on the training set, as with cross training, the accu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: racy dropped from 0.9595 to 0.9266 whereas the drop in accu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: racy in this study is from 0.9480 to 0.9456; thus, the technique

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: appears to be more robust to the training set used. This train-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing set robustness allows our algorithm to be used on multiple

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets without retraining, which is very useful for large-scale

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: screening programs. The algorithm achieves best accuracy in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: case of the cross-trained classifier for DRIVE and STARE; the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cross-trained accuracy of Marin [24] is slightly better. However

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as reported this is in part due to the preprocessing performed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for contrast, illumination and back ground normalization. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposed method does not include any preprocessing of reti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nal images before feature extraction with the goal of improving

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computational performance and avoiding the risk of thin vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: removal.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In addition, the simplicity of the method should also be high-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lighted. The method computes only nine features for pixel classi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fication and only four features in the case of the reduced feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: set, thus utilizing less computational time. The time required

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to train the classifier for the DRIVE database with 2 * 10⁴

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training samples and 200 decision trees is 100 s and the ensem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ble for STARE with 75 000 training samples and 200 decision

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trees takes 49 s. In comparison, the GMM classifier used by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Soares [21] is trained in approximately 8 h. The total time re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quired to process a single image is ~100 s, running on a PC

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with an Intel Core2Duo CPU at 2.27 GHz and 4 GB of RAM.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Since this method is experimentally implemented in MATLAB

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 7.13, this performance might still be improved.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The performance metrics of most of the vessel segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: algorithms in the literature are calculated on a small number

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of images of adults with particular morphological character-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: istics. The morphological characteristics of retinal images of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: premature infants and children are very different from those

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the adult retina. Choroidal vessels are more visible along-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: side the retinal vessels in retinal images taken from premature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: infants [3]. A bright central reflex on the vessels and illumina-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion artifacts contribute to challenges in image processing when

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: retinal images from school children are considered [3]. The lim-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ited range of images in the DRIVE and STARE databases does

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: not cater for a variable range of image-related characteristics

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such as interimage and intraimage variabilities in luminance,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: drift in contrast, and uneven background gray level values. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolutions of images from the STARE and DRIVE datasets are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: limited to 0.4 and 0.3 megapixels, respectively. While this lower

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolution is acceptable for certain analyses such as fractal di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mension or tortuosity, calculating the vessel diameter normally

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: requires higher resolution images to achieve higher precision.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Therefore, a new dataset of retinal images acquired from mul-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tiethnic school children along with vessel segmentation ground

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: truths has been made publicly available. The new dataset is a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: subset of images from CHASE, which aims to study the cardio-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vascular risk factors in children of different ethnic origin; images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can be downloaded from the database website. This dataset is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: intended to facilitate the development and comparison of vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation and vessel measurement algorithms.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The demonstrated performance, effectiveness, and robust-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ness, along with its simplicity and speed in training as well

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as in classification, make this ensemble-based method for blood

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel segmentation a suitable tool to be integrated into a com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plete retinal image analysis system for clinical purposes and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in particular for large population studies. In future, we aim to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: incorporate the vessel width and tortousity measures into the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: algorithm and to develop an interactive vessel analysis software

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tool for ophthalmologists.
